about: D77 no-legacy-path audit: every flag and environment input of the shipped tools (sgo, compile, asm, link) is S-Go-specified, refused (with a test), or inert (with a test). legacy-audit.py checks this file against the tools and their sources; anything unclassified, stale, or untested fails.

flags.about: compile, asm, and link: the flags the sgo driver writes are listed in each tool's refuse-by-default allowlist (base/sgoflags.go, cmd/asm/main.go, ld/sgoidcfg.go); legacy-audit.py checks that the driver writes each of them and runs the tool with every other flag of its table, requiring a refusal with no output. The list below is the reviewed table: a flag added upstream is unclassified until it is added here.

values.about: values legacy-audit.py passes to a refused flag that takes one, so the S-Go check (not upstream value parsing) decides; any other non-boolean flag gets 'x'; @EMPTYJSON is a file holding {}

info.about: flags that print and exit before anything is read or written (the version); legacy-audit.py requires that they write no output

env.about: Environment variables read by the shipped tools' sources (src/cmd/{sgo,compile,asm,link}, src/cmd/internal, src/internal/buildcfg) and by the Go runtime and standard library they run on. class: pinned (the driver sets a fixed value in every tool's environment, toolchain.go toolEnv), refused (a tool refuses any other value, tested), driver (an S-Go-specified input of the driver), inert (no effect on what is built: legacy-audit.py builds with the variable set and requires byte-identical objects and binaries), other-target (read only for a GOOS/GOARCH S-Go does not admit, which the tools refuse first), unshipped (read only by code no shipped tool links).

GOOS.note: the target; sgo refuses unadmitted targets (SGO_E_TARGET)

GOARCH.note: the target; sgo refuses unadmitted targets (SGO_E_TARGET)

SGO_CACHE.note: location of the driver's cache (SGO-TOOL-001); entries are verified on reuse (SGO-TCB-002 v2, D-R8)

TMPDIR.note: location of temporary files; passed to the tools for that purpose only

HOME.note: default cache location (os.UserCacheDir) when SGO_CACHE is unset

XDG_CACHE_HOME.note: default cache location on linux (os.UserCacheDir) when SGO_CACHE is unset

GOSSAFUNC.note: writes a debug ssa.html when set on a direct compile; the object is unchanged and the driver never passes it

GOCLOBBERDEADHASH.note: used only with -clobberdead, which is refused

GO_EXTLINK_ENABLED.code: link mode external is not admitted
GO_EXTLINK_ENABLED.note: selects external linking, which is refused (SGO-BUILD-001)

driver.about: The sgo driver parses its flags by hand (main.go, lab.go, check.go, test.go, fmt.go). legacy-audit.py extracts every flag name those parsers compare against and requires it to be listed here and named in the specification (sgo/spec/*.md); each command must refuse an unknown flag with SGO_E_USAGE.

not_flags.testdata: a directory name the module loader skips, not a flag
not_flags.vendor: a directory name: required modules' sources (SGO-IMP-003), skipped as packages of the main module, not a flag

archive.about: legacy-audit.py builds the release archive with make-release.py and requires: the only executables are bin/sgo and pkg/tool/<os>_<arch>/{sgo,compile,asm,link}; every file under src/ is a file of sgo/TARGET_TCB.json (or an assembler header it includes) and every TCB file is present; no top-level entry other than these.
